title: Scathe: 49 Battle Damage Presets Drawn Into Your Own Sprites, for Godot 4
shortText: Battle damage drawn into your own Godot 4 sprites: 7 marks on 7 materials, 49 presets, HP wear.
html:
Scathe: battle damage drawn into your own sprites, for Godot 4

Scathe is a Godot 4.7 addon that draws the damage every hit leaves on your own enemy and player sprites: 49 presets, 7 kinds of mark on 7 materials, and an HP band wear that grinds the whole sprite down as its health falls. One canvas shader and one Scathe node; nothing to paint, no damaged variants. A free MIT lite (12 presets) is on this page.

# add a Scathe node under your Sprite2D, then in your combat code:
$Enemy/Scathe.take_damage(amount, max_hp, "Fire Breath")   # lowers health, draws a SCORCH mark

The element NAME picks the mark, so your own element list works: fire burns, ice frosts, thunder burns a branching scar, poison bruises, earth cracks, acid eats through, anything else cuts. Each new mark lands on a part of the body thick enough to hold it, away from the marks already there, and never outside the sprite's outline.

7 kinds of mark

  • Cut: a lens shaped gash with a broken lit lip; bleeds and runs on flesh and scale.
  • Crack: a crack network and radial spokes in the material's own colour in shadow, bare material on dark surfaces.
  • Scorch: char with a smouldering ember rim and sparks; metal tempers, spirit burns through, slime boils.
  • Rime: a coat of frost that keeps the form under it, a bright rim and four point crystals.
  • Shock: a charred strike and a Lichtenberg burn branching out from it, with a faint glint.
  • Blight: a creeping bruise with a sore at its heart and a few thick dark veins.
  • Acid: pitted corrosion that eats through the body, with acid running down.

7 materials, 7 responses

  • Flesh (shown on the Ogre): cuts bleed and run.
  • Scale (shown on the Wyvern): cuts open pale under scale and bleed dark.
  • Shell (shown on the Scarab): chips to pale chitin.
  • Stone (shown on the Golem): gouges with a chipped crater.
  • Metal (shown on the Haunted Armour): scores to bright steel, tempers under fire.
  • Slime (shown on the Ooze): splits wet, boils under fire.
  • Spirit (shown on the Wraith): tears give light, fire burns through.

A material is a small resource: colours plus five switches (hard, metal, drips, glow, gel). Duplicate one for your own creature.

The HP bands

Below 75%, 50% and 25% of health the whole sprite looks one step more worn: its colour drains, its outline darkens, grime sinks in, and at the last band the outline takes bites. Healing lifts the wear and keeps the marks. The bands, the mark limit, the size and a pixel grid snap (for pixel art drawn at 2x, 3x or 4x) are properties on the node.

What is in it

  • scathe.gdshader: every mark and all of the wear, per pixel, on the GPU, every frame.
  • Scathe node: hit(), hit_element(), take_damage(), health, mend(), signals marked and band_changed.
  • 7 materials and 49 preset scenes (7 x 7), each a short fight on a demo creature.
  • Seven painted demo creatures (ogre, wyvern, scarab, golem, haunted armour, ooze, wraith) and a painted battleback, yours to use in your games.
  • A demo you drive: keys 1 to 7 strike, left and right change creature, H heals, M mends, Space runs an automatic fight.
  • Plain GDScript and one shader, no GDExtension, no plugin to enable. Works on Sprite2D and TextureRect.

Both renderers, tested

Every preset photographed under Forward+ and Compatibility (the renderer web exports use): 49 + 49 frames, zero engine errors, each preset measured against its creature untouched and all 49 distinct. 50 damaged creatures on screen at once (16 marks each, the last HP band) averaged under 15 ms a frame on both renderers, no frame over 40 ms.

Free lite on this page

Scathe Lite is free (MIT): cut, scorch, rime and blight on flesh, slime and spirit (12 of the 49), the same node, the same demo with three creatures.

Install

Copy addons/scathe into your project. No plugin to enable.

Licence

Royalty free in your games, commercial use, no credit required, demo creatures included. Edit and recolour freely. You may not resell or redistribute the files as an asset pack, addon, shader collection or art pack. Plain language LICENSE.txt included.

AI disclosure, stated truthfully: the shader, scripts and demo were written with AI, the demo creatures and battleback were painted by an AI image model, and every mark is drawn by that code at runtime from your own sprite.
